extraction: Claude DevFleet manual sequential with review workflow. 1) create_project(name="...") -> project_id. 2) create_mission(project_id, title="Implement feature", prompt="...") -> impl_mission_id. 3) dispatch_mission(mission_id=impl_mission_id), poll get_mission_status until complete. 4) get_report(mission_id=impl_mission_id) to review results. 5) create_mission(project_id, title="Review", prompt="...", depends_on=[impl_mission_id], auto_dispatch=true) - auto-starts since dependency already met. Full auto workflow: plan_project -> show plan -> get approval -> dispatch first mission -> remaining auto-dispatch as deps complete -> poll dashboard -> get_report for each terminal mission. Missions form DAG - no circular dependencies. Each agent runs in isolated git worktree, auto-merges on completion. Merge conflicts remain on agent's worktree branch for manual resolution.
